name: Architecture and Landscape Architecture
description: Designing buildings and the land around them, and the drafting work that supports both. ⚠⚠⚠ The one thing that governs this family: Florida licenses architects by STATUTE on a degree from a programme accredited by the National Architectural Accrediting Board, and only SIX Florida institutions hold one — five public, one private. A four-year architecture bachelor's that is not one of them is a pre-professional degree, not a licence route.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE ACCREDITED DEGREES ARE SPLIT ACROSS TWO CIP CODES, AND ANCHORING ON THE OBVIOUS ONE MISSES HALF THE STATE. Architecture (04.0201) holds 273 Florida credentials — UF 175, USF 48 master's, UCF 43 bachelor's, FAMU 6. ⚠⚠ But FAU awards NO bachelor's under that code while holding an accredited B.Arch, and FIU awards NO master's under it while holding an accredited M.Arch: their output — FAU 61 bachelor's, FIU 152 master's — is filed under Architectural and Building Sciences/Technology (04.0902), 277 more credentials. ⚠ This programme claims both, so the school list is the real one. ⚠⚠⚠ WHICH DEGREE EACH SCHOOL HOLDS IS THE DECISION. NAAB accredits FAMU (B.Arch and M.Arch), FAU (B.Arch), FIU (M.Arch), UF (M.Arch), USF (M.Arch) and the private University of Miami (both). ⚠⚠ Two of those award an accredited BACHELOR'S; three do not, so at UF, USF or FIU the licence route runs through the master's. ⚠⚠⚠ UCF IS NOT ON THE NAAB LIST, and it is the state's second-largest architecture bachelor's producer. Its Bachelor of Design in Architecture is deliberately pre-professional: a 2+2+2 with Valencia College and UF, ending in UF's accredited M.Arch at CityLab Orlando. ⚠ That is a real route, not a gap — but a UCF student must plan on the master's from day one. ⚠ THE THIRD ROUTE IS DIFFERENT IN KIND: Architectural Technology (04.0901) is an ASSOCIATE degree at 8 state colleges and leads to drafting work, not to registration. Verify any programme at naab.org before you enrol.

cips.note: Architecture — 5 Florida public institutions and 273 credentials: UF 175 (88 bachelor's, 68 master's, 19 postbaccalaureate certificates), USF 48 master's, UCF 43 bachelor's, FAMU 6 bachelor's, FIU 1 certificate. ⚠⚠ Claimed together with 04.0902 because this code alone misses FAU's and FIU's accredited programmes entirely.

Architectural and Building Sciences/Technology — 4 Florida public institutions and 277 credentials: FIU 152 master's and 1 doctorate, FAU 61 bachelor's, FAMU 34 bachelor's and 6 master's, UF 23 doctorates. ⚠⚠⚠ FAU's accredited B.Arch and FIU's accredited M.Arch are counted HERE, not under 04.02 — which is why a school list built from the obvious code would have left both out.

Architectural Technology/Technician — 8 Florida public institutions and 59 associate degrees: St Petersburg College 15, Florida SouthWestern 14, Hillsborough 9, Pensacola State 8, Miami Dade 7, FSCJ 3, Gulf Coast 2, Northwest Florida State 1. ⚠⚠ This is the DRAFTING route. It leads to architectural and civil drafting work, median $66,150, and NOT to registration as an architect.

Landscape Architecture — 2 Florida public institutions and 36 credentials: FIU 19 master's, UF 14 bachelor's and 3 master's. ⚠ A separately licensed profession, regulated under chapter 481 PART II rather than Part I, with its own accreditor and its own exam. Median $79,870 against architecture's $99,280, but only 23,500 jobs nationally.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The closest neighbour and the honest alternative. Construction management is 30 Florida institutions against architecture's 6, needs no accredited-degree statute, and construction managers earn a $114,990 median — well ABOVE architects. ⚠ A student who wants to make buildings happen rather than to author them should look hard at this before committing to a five-to-eight-year licence route.

⚠ Where the architectural technology associate degree actually leads: architectural and civil drafters, 104,100 jobs, +5% against drafting overall at +1%. ⚠⚠ It is also the standard way to work in an architecture office while finishing a degree — the hours can count toward the experience requirement if they are supervised properly.

⚠⚠ The comparison that changes who applies: architecture at UF asks transfer applicants for PRECALCULUS and ALGEBRA-BASED physics; civil engineering asks for the calculus sequence and calculus-based physics. ⚠ Students who rule themselves out of building design because of mathematics are usually thinking of the engineering requirement, not the architecture one.

⚠ Named because the portfolio, the software and the studio critique are shared — Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Illustrator and Photoshop all appear in the architecture technology list. ⚠⚠ The difference is the licence: design work is unregulated, and sealing a building drawing is not.
